## Change contract

- [ ] I described the behavior or invariant this change establishes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran `dotnet format Peerfluence.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant test suite(s) and recorded any intentionally skipped checks.
- [ ] I checked dependency, logging, cancellation, disposal, and culture-sensitive code paths.
- [ ] I kept unrelated formatting or refactoring out of this change.
